originality.rationale: Finch (2015) explicitly frames this fixed-four-cap intermediate-radius problem and provides only bounds; the present claim proves an exact leading coefficient and conditional local shape law at the minimal covering radius, neither identified in accessible primary full-text portions or published research-record search. Distinct regimes of Bürgisser–Cucker–Lotz and Brauchart et al. do not imply the stated fixed-four near-threshold formula. This is a best-knowledge originality assessment, not a proof of historical priority.
residual_risks: No independent historical survey; exact special-case coverage formulas may be hidden in older geometric-probability sources including Gilbert (1965) and Moran (1962).
Maehara (1988) complete text unavailable; its abstract concerns large N but only abstract-level inference is appropriate.
General spherical-polytope asymptotic theory or a library implementation could imply the endpoint coefficient without explicit parameter matching.
